exams.name: Airport Firefighter
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1003 for firefighters who operate aircraft rescue and firefighting apparatus at airports.

exams.name: Certified Fire Investigator I
exams.blurb: An IAAI/NICET certified fire investigator credential at level one validating cause-and-origin investigation fundamentals.

exams.name: Certified Fire Investigator II
exams.blurb: An advanced IAAI/NICET fire investigator credential for complex investigations, testimony and technical failure analysis.

exams.name: Certified Fire Plan Examiner
exams.blurb: A certification for professionals who review fire protection and life-safety plans for code compliance before construction.

exams.name: Certified Fire Protection Specialist
exams.blurb: A certification validating broad knowledge of fire prevention, protection systems, codes and risk analysis across the fire service.

exams.name: Driver/Operator - Aerial
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1002 for firefighters who drive, position and operate aerial ladder and tower apparatus safely.

exams.name: Driver/Operator - Pumper
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1002 for firefighters who drive, position and operate fire apparatus pumps at emergency incidents.

exams.name: Fire Inspector I
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1031 for inspectors conducting plan review and fire code inspections of existing buildings.

exams.name: Fire Inspector II
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1031 for inspectors performing complex plan reviews and fire investigations beyond Inspector I scope.

exams.name: Fire Instructor I
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1041 qualifying firefighters to deliver and evaluate prepared fire service training lessons.

exams.name: Fire Instructor II
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1041 for instructors who develop lesson plans and coordinate training programs within a fire agency.

exams.name: Fire Instructor III
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1041 for fire service training officers managing a full training division and instructional staff.

exams.name: Fire Investigator
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1033 for investigators who determine fire cause and origin and document evidence for legal proceedings.

exams.name: Fire Officer I
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1021 for the first-level company officer supervising personnel and managing single-unit emergency incidents.

exams.name: Fire Officer II
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1021 for company officers managing multi-unit incidents and assisting with department-level administration.

exams.name: Fire Officer III
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1021 for battalion-level officers managing multiple companies and department-wide programs and budgets.

exams.name: Fire Officer IV
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1021 for chief officers responsible for agency policy, interagency coordination and executive leadership.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Awareness
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 472/1072 for responders who recognize a hazmat incident and initiate protective actions without contact.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Incident Commander
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 472/1072 for commanders who assume overall management and strategy at hazardous materials incidents.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Operations
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 472/1072 for responders who defend in place and perform limited protective actions at hazmat incidents.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Technician
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 472/1072 for technicians who control spills and leaks through chemical protective clothing and mitigation.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Confined Space
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who enter and extricate victims from permit-required confined spaces safely.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Rope
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who perform high-angle and confined rope rescue operations using rigging systems.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Structural Collapse
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who locate and extricate victims from collapsed buildings after disasters.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Trench
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who shore and excavate to rescue victims from collapsed trench environments.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Vehicle
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who perform machinery and vehicle extrication using cutting and lifting tools.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Water
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who perform surface and shallow-water rescue of victims from moving or still water.

exams.name: Rescue Technician - Wilderness
exams.blurb: A certification per NFPA 1006 for technicians who search for and extricate patients in remote backcountry environments.

exams.name: FEMA Independent Study Courses
exams.blurb: Free self-paced online FEMA courses covering emergency management, hazards and the National Incident Management System basics.

exams.name: FEMA Professional Development Series
exams.blurb: A certificate series of required FEMA IS courses that forms the foundation for emergency management professional development.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-100
exams.blurb: The introductory NIMS incident command system course for all personnel expected to work in an ICS environment during incidents.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-200
exams.blurb: The intermediate ICS course for personnel who serve as single-resource or task-lead supervisors within an incident command structure.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-300
exams.blurb: The advanced ICS course for those who command expanding incidents and manage multiple operational periods and resources.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-400
exams.blurb: The command and general-staff ICS course covering area command and multi-agency coordination for complex incidents.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-700
exams.blurb: The National Incident Management System overview course required for understanding NIMS principles across all responder disciplines.

exams.name: NIMS ICS-800
exams.blurb: The national response framework course explaining how communities and agencies coordinate during domestic incident response.

exams.name: FireTEAM Test
exams.blurb: A video-based entry exam for firefighters measuring human relations, math, mechanical and reading skills plus a situational judgment section.

exams.name: Behavioral Personnel Assessment Device
exams.blurb: A video-based oral interview test presenting job scenarios to measure the interpersonal judgment of public safety applicants.
